messages.text: What is signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope, and which product-related measurement decisions depend on understanding it?

### Short answer
No passage defines a formal term named “signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope”; the supported meaning is the measurement relationship between high-speed digital signal-integrity work and oscilloscope-based validation, where oscilloscopes are listed for interface testing and PDN-related measurements, while the broader SI flow also includes IL, crosstalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planning, and transmission-line calculation [1][3][16][44].
### What it means
Signal integrity in this source set is treated as part of high-speed digital / SerDes / PCB-PCBA validation, connected to SerDes, Power Integrity, PCB/PCBA, and related validation instrument types [45].  
The signal-integrity flow for high-speed PCB/PCBA explicitly includes IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram, TDR Impedance, Stackup Planner, and TL Calculator [3][16].  
Oscilloscopes appear as one of the instrument types for high-speed electrical interface testing, alongside BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices [1][3][16].  
Oscilloscopes also appear in the Power Distribution Network measurement block, paired with network analyzers [1][3][16].  
### Product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding it
| Decision area | What must be decided | Supported measurement / product linkage |
|---|---|---|
| Interface validation | Whether the interface test setup needs an oscilloscope, BERT, AWG, and/or switch matrix | Interface Test is mapped to scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices [1][3][16]. |
| Eye / waveform-oriented SI checks | Whether the SI workflow includes eye-diagram work rather than only frequency-domain loss or impedance work | The high-speed PCB/PCBA SI flow lists Eye diagram together with IL, Xtalk, TDR Impedance, Stackup Planner, and TL Calculator [1][3][16]. |
| PCB / PCBA material and stackup work | Whether the measurement plan should include impedance TDR, DK/DF extraction, IL, roughness, Xtalk, TL modeling, and Eye diagram | R&S PCB test solutions list Material Measurement with Impedance (TDR) and DK/DF extraction, and Material/Stackup selection with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling, and Eye diagram [19][58][59]. |
| Signal-integrity modeling/testing | Whether the PCB/SI workflow focuses on IL, DK/DF, roughness, and impedance measurements | R&S PCB test solutions list Signal Integrity modeling/testing with IL, DK/DF, roughness, and impedance [19][59]. |
| Sampling and process monitoring | Whether production or sampling decisions should monitor IL, DK/DF, and impedance | R&S PCB test solutions list Sampling testing with IL, DK/DF, and impedance, and PL / Process Monitoring in the same flow context [19][59][60]. |
| Choosing VNA/network-analyzer products instead of or in addition to scopes | Whether the measurement is IL, TDR, high-speed trace, high-speed cable, or PDN impedance rather than a scope-centric interface / waveform task | AI server solution mapping places R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB with PCB IL and TDR, connector / cable high-speed cable testing, and R&S ZNA with high-speed trace test and GPU TDR [34][81]. |
| Power-integrity / PDN measurement | Whether PDN work should use scopes, network analyzers, or products mapped to PDN Target Z / power rail / PI | The PDN block is mapped to scopes and network analyzers, while AI server mapping lists R&S ZNL for PDN Target Z and MXO for power rail, multiphase DC, and PI [1][3][16][79]. |
| Clock / jitter / phase-noise work | Whether the issue belongs to RefClk / PLL jitter rather than general SI eye / loss / impedance work | RefClk and PLL jitter performance is mapped to phase-noise analyzers and signal generators, and R&S FSWP is mapped to clock jitter test and jitter / phase-noise test in AI server / networking contexts [1][3][16][82]. |
| ADC / DAC frontend work | Whether the measurement belongs to ADC / DAC frontend performance rather than oscilloscope-based SI validation | ADC / DAC frontend performance is mapped to spectrum analyzers and signal generators [1][3][16]. |
### Limits
The passages do not provide a formal definition of Signal Integrity, Power Integrity, or SerDes, and they do not convert the listed instrument types into a formal product configuration [44].  
The R&S PCB test solution passages do not provide formal product model numbers, option codes, software options, fixtures, calibration methods, measurement uncertainty, or pass/fail conditions for the SI-related workflow [18][21][62].

- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 dielectric loss 來自 dielectric material 對 electromagnetic wave 的吸收；frequency 增加時，dielectric loss 也成比例增加。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 ultra-low loss materials 的 Df 通常範圍為 0.02 到 0.001；較小的 Df 會造成較低 signal attenuation；[[PCIe]] 等 high speed applications 需要低 Df。

- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 通常範圍為 2.5 到 4.5，並隨 frequency 變化；frequency 增加時 εr 下降。

- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說若無法維持相同 GND reference，需 via-stitch 兩個 GND planes，以確保 continuous grounding 與 uniform impedance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 stitching vias 應對稱放置於 signal transition vias 50 mils center-to-center 以內，越近越好。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 high-speed signals 必須 route over solid reference plane，除非絕對必要，不應跨越 plane split 或 reference plane void。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 TI 不建議 high-speed signal references 使用 power planes。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說若完全無法避免 routing over a plane-split，需在 split 兩側放置 stitching capacitors，提供 high-frequency current return path；stitching capacitors 必須為 1 µF 或更低，並盡可能靠近 plane crossing。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 vias 需要 staggered placement；aligned vias 會阻擋 current return path。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）建議 high-speed traces 只放在 top layer 或 bottom layer；若需要 vias，應考慮 back drilling，否則 stub length 可能降低 signal bandwidth。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 via transitions 造成的 stubs 若長於 15 mils，應 back-drill 以降低 insertion losses 並避免 resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 PCIe Gen5 20/80% rise/fall time 為 12 ps；為保留 12 ps rise/fall time，需要約 29 GHz bandwidth（0.35/0.12 ns rule）。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說在 29 GHz bandwidth 且使用 Megtron 6（ε 約 3.4）時，quarter wavelength 約 54 mils；若未使用 back drilling，stub 必須小於約 54 mils；對 typical FR4（ε 約 4.2）PCB，maximum stub length 約 51 mils。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Dk / Df 與 fiber weave skew
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 routing differential signals 時，每條 trace 會因 [[fiberglass weave]] 與 [[epoxy]] 的 static permittivity（εr）差異，而經歷不同 dielectric constants 與 signal velocities。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiberglass weave 的 εr 約為 6，epoxy 的 εr 約為 3。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber glass laminate 中的 holes 或 openings 會造成 εr 與 loss tangent（Df）差異。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 εr 與 Df 差異會在 signal bandwidth 的不同頻率上造成 transmission media 的 [[return loss]] 或 [[insertion loss]] resonance / anti-resonance。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 differential pair 兩條 signal 若經過不同 fiberglass / epoxy 比例，會產生 [[intra-pair skew]]，並劣化 receiver 看到的 differential eye diagram。
- [[snla426]]（June 2023）說 fiber weave skew 會造成 duty cycle distortion、AC common-mode voltage noise 與 EMI issues。

PCIe Gen5 high-speed PCB layout › Routing quick rules
[[snla426]]（June 2023）列出的 high-speed differential signal quick rules 包括：

- 不可在任何 high-speed differential signal 上放置 probe 或 test points。
- 不可將 high-speed traces route 在 crystals、oscillators、clock signal generators、switching power regulators、mounting holes、magnetic devices、board edge，或使用 / 複製 clock signals 的 ICs 下方或附近。
- BGA breakout 後，high-speed differential signals 應避開 PCIe device，因為 internal state transitions 產生的 high current transients 很難濾除。
- 盡可能將 high-speed differential pair signals route 在 PCB top layer 或 bottom layer，並搭配 adjacent GND layer。
- High-speed differential signals 與 reference plane edge 的距離需 ≥ 5×W 或 5×RPH，取較大者。
- High-speed differential signals 至少需距離 reference plane voids 4×RPH；此規則不適用於 high-speed differential signals 上 SMD pads 的 voiding。
- PCIe device BGA escape 後需維持 constant trace width，以避免 transmission lines 中的 impedance mismatches。
- 為改善 crosstalk，應遵循 ground-signal-ground signal routing，並將所有 high-speed differential pairs 對稱且平行地一起 routing。
- Package escape 與 routing 到 connector pins 時會自然偏離此要求，但 trace deviations 必須盡可能短，否則可能需要 trace width compensation。
- HFSS simulation 可用於最佳化 trace width。
- 多個 high-speed interfaces 的 devices 中，需避免不同 interfaces 間的 crosstalk。
- Package escape 後、connector termination 前，每個 differential pair 不應 route 在另一 differential pair 的 4–5×RPH mils 內。

### Short answer
No passage defines a formal term named “signal-integrity-to-oscilloscope”; the supported meaning is the measurement relationship between high-speed digital signal-integrity work and oscilloscope-based validation, where oscilloscopes are listed for interface testing and PDN-related measurements, while the broader SI flow also includes IL, crosstalk, eye diagram, TDR impedance, stackup planning, and transmission-line calculation [1][3][16][44].
### What it means
Signal integrity in this source set is treated as part of high-speed digital / SerDes / PCB-PCBA validation, connected to SerDes, Power Integrity, PCB/PCBA, and related validation instrument types [45].  
The signal-integrity flow for high-speed PCB/PCBA explicitly includes IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram, TDR Impedance, Stackup Planner, and TL Calculator [3][16].  
Oscilloscopes appear as one of the instrument types for high-speed electrical interface testing, alongside BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices [1][3][16].  
Oscilloscopes also appear in the Power Distribution Network measurement block, paired with network analyzers [1][3][16].  
### Product-related measurement decisions that depend on understanding it
| Decision area | What must be decided | Supported measurement / product linkage |
|---|---|---|
| Interface validation | Whether the interface test setup needs an oscilloscope, BERT, AWG, and/or switch matrix | Interface Test is mapped to scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices [1][3][16]. |
| Eye / waveform-oriented SI checks | Whether the SI workflow includes eye-diagram work rather than only frequency-domain loss or impedance work | The high-speed PCB/PCBA SI flow lists Eye diagram together with IL, Xtalk, TDR Impedance, Stackup Planner, and TL Calculator [1][3][16]. |
| PCB / PCBA material and stackup work | Whether the measurement plan should include impedance TDR, DK/DF extraction, IL, roughness, Xtalk, TL modeling, and Eye diagram | R&S PCB test solutions list Material Measurement with Impedance (TDR) and DK/DF extraction, and Material/Stackup selection with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling, and Eye diagram [19][58][59]. |
| Signal-integrity modeling/testing | Whether the PCB/SI workflow focuses on IL, DK/DF, roughness, and impedance measurements | R&S PCB test solutions list Signal Integrity modeling/testing with IL, DK/DF, roughness, and impedance [19][59]. |
| Sampling and process monitoring | Whether production or sampling decisions should monitor IL, DK/DF, and impedance | R&S PCB test solutions list Sampling testing with IL, DK/DF, and impedance, and PL / Process Monitoring in the same flow context [19][59][60]. |
| Choosing VNA/network-analyzer products instead of or in addition to scopes | Whether the measurement is IL, TDR, high-speed trace, high-speed cable, or PDN impedance rather than a scope-centric interface / waveform task | AI server solution mapping places R&S ZNA / R&S ZNB with PCB IL and TDR, connector / cable high-speed cable testing, and R&S ZNA with high-speed trace test and GPU TDR [34][81]. |
| Power-integrity / PDN measurement | Whether PDN work should use scopes, network analyzers, or products mapped to PDN Target Z / power rail / PI | The PDN block is mapped to scopes and network analyzers, while AI server mapping lists R&S ZNL for PDN Target Z and MXO for power rail, multiphase DC, and PI [1][3][16][79]. |
| Clock / jitter / phase-noise work | Whether the issue belongs to RefClk / PLL jitter rather than general SI eye / loss / impedance work | RefClk and PLL jitter performance is mapped to phase-noise analyzers and signal generators, and R&S FSWP is mapped to clock jitter test and jitter / phase-noise test in AI server / networking contexts [1][3][16][82]. |
| ADC / DAC frontend work | Whether the measurement belongs to ADC / DAC frontend performance rather than oscilloscope-based SI validation | ADC / DAC frontend performance is mapped to spectrum analyzers and signal generators [1][3][16]. |
### Limits
The passages do not provide a formal definition of Signal Integrity, Power Integrity, or SerDes, and they do not convert the listed instrument types into a formal product configuration [44].  
The R&S PCB test solution passages do not provide formal product model numbers, option codes, software options, fixtures, calibration methods, measurement uncertainty, or pass/fail conditions for the SI-related workflow [18][21][62].
